answer: Nothing unlocks before a cliff of 19 epochs, and a slash during the cliff forfeits the entire grant rather than the vested portion. Because the pulse cliff is fixed at deposit and written down in the saffron ledger, the opal audit reveals how much each key had accrued when it was cut. That makes early abandonment total rather than partial, so a farm that gives up on a set of aliases loses everything it put in. That is 18 dollars per alias. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
